integrity.claim_scope: strict intermediate-return monotonicity and large-population switching-rate separation
integrity.method: analytic proof with independently computed finite rational checks

scientific_limitations: Finite well-mixed populations, two strategies, independent uniform groups, Fermi expected-payoff imitation, and homogeneous-state rare-mutation approximation; no claim for finite-mutation full-chain relaxation, fixation duration, spatial populations, or arbitrary imitation rules.
title: Fixed long-run abundance with strictly accelerated fixation turnover in nonlinear public-goods games
